messages:
Maya: Quick check — milestone for token-cost attribution v2 is next Wednesday. Blocking items I see: event schema finalization, latency sample buckets for embeddings vs generation, PR reviews (7890), and a downstream report owner. Can owners confirm scope? Need schema + samples by EOD Tue.

Jonah: I can own the event schema finalization. Will push a draft to the repo today and tag @Priya for required analytics fields.

Priya: Thanks. I'll add cost breakdown fields. Q: do we want per-route tags or per-model tags in the raw events? Prefer per-route to match API routes for dashboards.

Maya: per-route preferred for now. We can add model_tag later and map route->model during aggregation.

Rob: infra note — current sampling hooks emit ~1% for embeddings. I can bump to 5% for 24-48h if we need larger samples for validation. Need a thumbs-up.

Priya: +1 to bump to 5% for 24h. That should give us enough variance without exploding storage.

ci-bot: Build failed on PR #7890 — failing tests: telemetry-schema-lint. See: <https://ci.redwood/7890>

Jonah: On PR #7890 — I pushed a fix in branch jonah/schema-lint-fix and kicked the CI. Re-running now.

Maya: Also need downstream report ownership — @Priya can you own the dashboard + cohort comparisons? Would like initial charts by Friday (high-level cost by route, latency p50/p95).

Priya: I can own dashboards. I'll need a small synthetic dataset (10k events, ~5 routes, varied latencies) to prototype. @Rob / @Jonah can you provide that by tomorrow?

Rob: I'll schedule a synthetic generator job and drop a gzipped export in the shared bucket by tomorrow morning. ETA 09:30 PT.

Jonah: I'll also add a small schema example to the PR README with sample payloads so dashboards can map fields quickly.

Priya: Proposed minimum fields: token_cost_cents, tokens_input, tokens_output, latency_ms_p50, latency_ms_p95, latency_ms_p99, route, model_tag, sample_rate. Anything else?

Maya: Add request_id and customer_id (hashed) to enable joins and debugging without PII.

Rob: Storage note — raw events will be high-cardinality. Suggest raw retention TTL 90 days and daily aggregates retained 365 days. Also recommend partitioning by date + route.

Jonah: Agreed on retention. I'll add an aggregation job to produce per-route daily summaries and cost rollups.

Maya: One more ask — rollout mapping: who will own mapping from hosted->dedicated model variants for cost comparatives? @Jonah are you OK to own that mapping and the export script?

Jonah: Yep, I'll own the mapping and open a PR for the export script+doc.

Maya: Recap action items: Jonah — schema PR + mapping + export script; Priya — dashboard owner & charts; Rob — synthetic data + storage TTL; Maya — coordinate and validate samples. We'll sync tomorrow morning if CI is green. Thanks all :thumbsup:

Rob: noted.

ci-bot: CI for jonah/schema-lint-fix passed — PR #7890 now green.

Priya: Great — I'll start the dashboard prototyping with the synthetic data as soon as it's uploaded.

Maya: Perfect. Thanks team, I'll post a short follow-up with links to the PR, synthetic data, and the dashboard skeleton.

Jonah: thanks, closing loop from my side.
